name: Portland Makers Guild
headline: Hands-on learning, shared tools, good people · Example Page
bio: This is an example page to show what a community organization looks like on the Project Library. The Portland Makers Guild is a fictional group for woodworking, textiles, and skill shares.
aboutContent:
This is an example page created to demonstrate how organizations and community groups appear on the Project Library. The Portland Makers Guild is fictional.

The Portland Makers Guild is a volunteer-run community of builders, tinkerers, and craftspeople.

We run monthly skill shares, host open shop nights, and maintain a shared tool library available to all members.

Membership is $30/month and includes unlimited shop access and one free skill share per quarter.

posts.title: New woodworking tools in the library (Example Post)
posts.content:
This is an example post showing what a page's posts look like on the Project Library.

We just added a set of Japanese pull saws and a low-angle block plane to the tool library. Come by open shop night to try them out.

As always, tools are free to borrow for members. Non-members can try them during open shop hours.

events.title: August Skill Share: Intro to Hand Sewing (Example Event)
events.content:
This is an example event showing what page-hosted events look like on the Project Library.

Learn the basics of hand sewing — running stitch, backstitch, and blanket stitch. Bring a project or use one of our practice kits.

All skill levels welcome. Materials provided. Free for members, $10 for non-members.
events.location: Portland Makers Guild, 3456 SE Division St, Portland, OR
